_comment: Citation registry. Every displayed number references a source id here (Principle 2: verify-and-cite). Add/verify entries before showing new figures.

cdc_ts_data.label: CDC — Data & Statistics on Tourette Syndrome
cdc_ts_data.note: Diagnosed prevalence ~1 in 333 (0.3%) US children 3-17; parent-reported NSCH.

nsch_prev_bmc.label: Prevalence of TS among US children and adolescents, 2016-2022

psychres_2022.label: Estimating the number of people with TS and persistent tic disorder in the US

comorbid_pmc.label: Lifetime prevalence of psychiatric comorbidity in TS
comorbid_pmc.note: ~86% any comorbidity; ~72% OCD and/or ADHD; only ~10-15% 'pure' TS.

comorbid_anx_dep.label: Depression & anxiety in TS: systematic review & meta-analysis

aan_2019.label: AAN 2019 Practice Guideline: Treatment of Tics in TS and Chronic Tic Disorders
aan_2019.note: Watchful waiting; CBIT first-line; alpha-2 agonists Level B; antipsychotics risk-gated.

treatment_review_pmc.label: A Review of the Current Treatment of Tourette Syndrome
treatment_review_pmc.note: FDA-approved TS drugs (haloperidol, pimozide, aripiprazole) and class liabilities.

jamaneuro_ph3.label: Efficacy and Safety of Ecopipam for TS: Phase 3 (D1AMOND)
jamaneuro_ph3.note: Gilbert DL et al., JAMA Neurol 2026;83(7):645-653 (online May 26, 2026). n=216 open-label; 104 randomized (90 pediatric, 14 adult). Pediatric relapse HR 0.5, P=.008; combined HR 0.5, P=.005. No clinically meaningful effect on weight, metabolic or psychiatric measures.

peds_ph2b.label: Ecopipam for Tourette Syndrome: A Randomized Trial (Phase 2b)
peds_ph2b.note: >150 children; ~30% YGTSS-TTS reduction vs placebo, P=.01.

mdcp_ext.label: Safety & effect of 12-month ecopipam treatment in pediatric TS
mdcp_ext.note: Durable tic reduction; no adverse BMI/lipid/HbA1c trends; no tachyphylaxis.

teva_nda.label: Teva Submits NDA for Ecopipam (pediatric TS)
teva_nda.note: NDA submitted June 18, 2026; Orphan + Fast Track.

teva_emalex_close.label: Teva Closes Acquisition of Emalex Biosciences
teva_emalex_close.note: $700M upfront + up to $200M milestones; closed June 10, 2026.

taa_coe.label: Tourette Association of America — Centers of Excellence
taa_coe.note: 28 designated Centers of Excellence as of Feb 2025; at least one added since (Univ. of Minnesota, Apr 2026). Confirm live roster.

aap_medicaid.label: AAP analysis: 49% of children insured by Medicaid or CHIP

cbit_piacentini.label: Behavior therapy for children with TS (CBIT pivotal RCT)
cbit_piacentini.note: 52.5% CBIT vs 18.5% control much/very much improved; NNT=3.

artists_fail.label: Deutetrabenazine in pediatric TS (ARTISTS 1) — negative
artists_fail.note: YGTSS-TTS diff -0.7, P=0.69; ARTISTS 2 also negative. No TS indication.

neupulse_rct.label: Median nerve stimulation for tics (Neupulse) — sham-controlled RCT
neupulse_rct.note: n=135; ~35% YGTSS-TTS reduction (secondary); primary endpoint was tic frequency.

noema_gemlapodect_ph2b.label: Noema Pharma — First Patients Dosed in Phase 2b Study of Gemlapodect (NOE-105) for Tourette Syndrome
noema_gemlapodect_ph2b.note: Phase 2b NOE-TTS-201 (NCT06315751): 12-wk, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, n=140, adults + adolescents; up to 15 mg QD; primary endpoint YGTSS-TTS; primary completion ~June 2026. Phase 2a (ALLEVIA-1) met primary and all key secondary endpoints. As of Nov 13, 2026 no Phase 2b topline has been located in press or registry searches; registry primary completion was estimated June 2026.

scisparc_sci110_ph2b.label: SciSparc Receives FDA Approval to Initiate Phase IIb Clinical Trial of SCI-110 for Tourette Syndrome
scisparc_sci110_ph2b.note: SCI-110 (dronabinol/THC + PEA) Phase 2b (NCT05126888): adults 18-65, double-blind placebo-controlled crossover (endpoints wk 12 & 26); sites include Yale, Hannover, Tel Aviv Sourasky. Prior Phase 2a: ~21% tic reduction.

axsome_balipodect.label: Axsome Therapeutics acquires global rights to Takeda's balipodect (PDE10A)
axsome_balipodect.note: Apr 1, 2026; balipodect (TAK-063) selective PDE10A inhibitor; 164-patient Phase 2 proof-of-concept in schizophrenia, safety in 360+ individuals; schizophrenia-lead plan with Tourette syndrome as a second indication.

eumentis_em221_cells.label: A Novel PDE10A Inhibitor (EM-221 / MR-1916) for Tourette Syndrome and Other Movement Disorders — Phase 1
eumentis_em221_cells.note: Peer-reviewed Phase 1: MTD 15 mg, PDE10A PET enzyme occupancy up to 92.8%, ~24 h half-life; Phase 2 in TS planned (company guidance, not a registered study).

neupulse_uk_launch.label: Neupulse Launches Wearable Median-Nerve Stimulation Device for Tourette Syndrome (UK)
neupulse_uk_launch.publisher: Neupulse / Neurotherapeutics Ltd (Clinical Research News Online)
neupulse_uk_launch.note: Wrist-worn rhythmic 10-Hz median-nerve stimulation; UK pre-orders live, delivery ~June 2026 subject to UK regulatory processes; no FDA clearance. University of Nottingham spin-out; positioned as a UK consumer wearable.

neurocrine_tforce_gold.label: Neurocrine: Phase 2b T-Force GOLD topline — valbenazine missed primary endpoint in pediatric TS
neurocrine_tforce_gold.note: Dec 12, 2018: valbenazine did not meet the YGTSS-TTS primary endpoint at week 12 in children/adolescents; TS program not pursued to approval. Second major VMAT2 failure in TS alongside deutetrabenazine.

teva_fy2025_results.label: Teva Q4 & FY2025 Results — Pivot to Growth Delivers Third Consecutive Year of Growth
teva_fy2025_results.note: FY2025 global revenue: Austedo ~$2.26B (+34%), Ajovy $673M (+30%), Uzedy $191M (+63%), all local currency; 'Pivot to Growth' four-pillar strategy with Austedo/Ajovy/Uzedy as innovative-brand engines. WebFetch 403 (site bot-block); verified via search summary of this release.

neurocrine_ingrezza_hd.label: Neurocrine — FDA Approval of INGREZZA (valbenazine) for Chorea Associated With Huntington's Disease
neurocrine_ingrezza_hd.note: Ingrezza approved for HD chorea Aug 2023; first FDA-approved treatment for tardive dyskinesia in April 2017. VMAT2 inhibitor.

noema_gemlapodect_ph2a.label: Noema Pharma: gemlapodect (NOE-105) Phase 2a ALLEVIA-1 met primary and all key secondary endpoints in TS
noema_gemlapodect_ph2a.note: Oct 17, 2024; first-in-class PDE10A inhibitor; n=15, 12-week open-label; ~60% responders overall (88% at target dose); reported weight-neutral. Phase 2b initiated.

noema_founding.label: Noema Pharma, Founded by Sofinnova Partners, Raises CHF 103M Series B
noema_founding.note: Swiss orphan-CNS company co-founded 2019/2020 by Sofinnova Partners; clinical assets in-licensed from Roche; Series B CHF103M (2023), extended to CHF130M (Dec 2024).

scisparc_sci110_nct.label: SCI-110 (dronabinol + PEA) Phase 2b crossover in adult Tourette syndrome (NCT05126888)
scisparc_sci110_nct.note: Multinational, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover in adults 18-65; proprietary cannabinoid (THC) + palmitoylethanolamide combination; adult-only program.

scisparc_ph2a.label: SciSparc — SCI-110 Phase 2a signal in adult Tourette syndrome (company-reported)
scisparc_ph2a.note: Company-reported open-label Phase 2a: ~21% tic reduction (YGTSS) in a small uncontrolled adult cohort; supported IND for the Phase 2b crossover. Uncontrolled/early-stage — treat as directional.

axsome_q1_2026.label: Axsome Therapeutics Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
axsome_q1_2026.note: Commercial CNS portfolio: Auvelity (MDD; Alzheimer's disease agitation, 2026), Sunosi/solriamfetol (excessive daytime sleepiness), Symbravo/meloxicam-rizatriptan (acute migraine).

emalex_paragon.label: Emalex Biosciences (Paragon Biosciences) — Ecopipam Meets Primary and Secondary Endpoints in Phase 3 TS Study
emalex_paragon.note: Emalex founded 2018 by Paragon Biosciences (Jeffrey Aronin); originator of ecopipam (selective D1 antagonist); focus on CNS movement and fluency disorders; Phase 3 D1AMOND met primary + secondary endpoints (topline Feb 2025).

fda_orphan_designation.label: FDA — Designating an Orphan Product: Drugs and Biological Products
fda_orphan_designation.note: Orphan designation incentives: 7-year marketing exclusivity on approval (same drug/same indication cannot be approved for another sponsor), PDUFA user-fee waiver, and orphan tax credit.

fda_rpd_prv.label: Give Kids a Chance Act — Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher reauthorization (H.R.1262 / CAA 2026)
fda_rpd_prv.note: RPD designation / transferable Priority Review Voucher program reauthorized through Sept 30, 2029 via the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act). Structurally available but NOT publicly confirmed for ecopipam.

fda_pediatric_exclusivity.label: Qualifying for Pediatric Exclusivity Under Section 505A of the FD&C Act (FAQ)
fda_pediatric_exclusivity.note: 6-month pediatric exclusivity earned by satisfying an FDA Written Request under BPCA; pediatric study results must be incorporated into labeling (BPCA/PREA). Stacks on existing exclusivity/patent term.

idea_ed.label: IDEA — Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (official ED site)
idea_ed.note: IEP eligibility for students needing specialized instruction; students with TS are typically classified under Other Health Impairment (OHI).

ed_section504.label: Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act — U.S. Department of Education
ed_section504.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, Office for Civil Rights
ed_section504.note: Civil-rights statute barring disability discrimination in federally funded programs; basis for 504 accommodation plans (extended time, movement breaks, preferential seating).

taa_iep_504.label: Tourette Association of America — IEP/504 Accommodations & Education Rights
taa_iep_504.note: TAA educator toolkit on IEP (OHI) vs 504 plans and TS-specific accommodations; documents the deliberate move away from the older 'emotional disturbance' classification.

taa_provider_directory.label: Find A Provider
taa_provider_directory.note: Searchable TAA provider directory filterable by location, patient age group, and clinical expertise including CBIT — the de facto referral rail to specialists and behavior therapists.

taa_bti_cbit.label: Tourette Association of America — Behavior Therapy Institute (TS-BTI) CBIT trainings
taa_bti_cbit.note: Train-the-trainer program (2-day training plus consultation, ending in a TS-BTI certificate and listing on the CBIT referral list) to expand the supply of CBIT-trained therapists.

macpac_prior_auth.label: MACPAC — Prior Authorization in Medicaid
macpac_prior_auth.publisher: MACPAC (Medicaid and CHIP Payment and Access Commission)
macpac_prior_auth.note: Prior authorization, step therapy, and preferred drug lists are the primary Medicaid outpatient-drug utilization-management tools; states set stringency program by program.

grandview_market.label: Tourette Syndrome Treatment Market — size & growth
grandview_market.note: ~$2.07B (2022), ~6.96% CAGR; base is largely generic/off-label. Third-party market estimate.

jefferies_peak.label: Teva/Emalex deal analysis — ecopipam peak-sales estimate
jefferies_peak.note: Sell-side estimate of up to ~$1B US peak sales; refractory/post-antipsychotic positioning. Third-party estimate.

census_pep.label: US Census Bureau — Population Estimates (state population by age)
census_pep.note: State under-18 age-share (2013) scaled to 2025 totals; used for directional per-state child population.

teva_nda_accept.label: FDA Accepts Teva's NDA and Grants Priority Review for Ecopipam (pediatric TS)
teva_nda_accept.note: Announced Aug 19, 2026. Priority Review; target action date late Q1 2027. Proposed indication is exclusively pediatric. Supported by Phase 2b + Phase 3 D1AMOND.

teva_mds_2026.label: Teva Presents New Efficacy and Safety Data with Ecopipam (MDS 2026)
teva_mds_2026.note: Oct 2026 (MDS Congress, Seoul). Post hoc: ~70% of participants had a clinically meaningful tic reduction within 8 weeks. Interim 18-month open-label extension: mean tic-severity reduction 45.6%, no new safety signals. Post hoc / open-label — directional, not controlled.

teva_q3_2026.label: Teva Q3 2026 Form 10-Q
teva_q3_2026.note: Confirms Emalex acquisition completed (~$700M paid) and ecopipam FDA decision expected Q1 2027.

tevaemalex_agree.label: Teva to Acquire Emalex Biosciences
tevaemalex_agree.note: Definitive agreement announced Apr 29, 2026: $700M upfront, up to $200M commercial milestones, plus net-sales royalties.

scisparc_ph2b_sites_2026.label: NeuroThera Labs (SciSparc) Launches Phase IIb at Yale Child Study Center
scisparc_ph2b_sites_2026.note: Hannover site live Jul 15, 2026; Yale site Aug 5, 2026; Oct 2026 European drug-batch release with all three sites initiated. Company-sourced.

neupulse_wellness_2026.label: New wrist stimulation device brings relief for people with Tourette's
neupulse_wellness_2026.note: Neupulse launched a 'wellness' wrist device (Neupulse C) in the UK; a medical-device version remains under regulatory development. No FDA clearance or US launch found.

taa_umn_coe_2026.label: University of Minnesota MnTiC Lab Designated a TAA Center of Excellence
taa_umn_coe_2026.note: Designated Apr 1, 2026 — evidence the CoE network has grown beyond the 28 counted in Feb 2025.

taa_ecopipam_update.label: Update on the FDA Acceptance of the NDA for Ecopipam
taa_ecopipam_update.note: Patient-advocacy statement on the Aug 2026 NDA acceptance.

aan_2019_sr.label: Comprehensive systematic review summary: Treatment of tics in people with Tourette syndrome and chronic tic disorders
aan_2019_sr.note: Evidence confidence by intervention. High: CBIT vs psychoeducation/supportive therapy. Moderate: haloperidol, risperidone, aripiprazole, tiapride, clonidine, onabotulinumtoxinA (among others). Low: pimozide, ziprasidone, metoclopramide, guanfacine, topiramate, THC. Verified from the abstract; full text not read.

openfda.label: openFDA — drug labels, Drugs@FDA, drug shortages, adverse event reports
openfda.note: Public FDA datasets queried via API. Adverse event counts are spontaneous reports, not incidence.

ctgov.label: ClinicalTrials.gov registry
ctgov.note: Sponsor-reported registry records for Tourette syndrome and tic disorders.

pubmed.label: PubMed
pubmed.note: Record counts for agent AND Tourette Syndrome[MeSH]; counts papers, not quality.

nppes.label: NPI Registry (NPPES)
nppes.note: Individual providers by self-reported taxonomy and practice-location state; overstates the active workforce.

medicaid_sdud.label: State Drug Utilization Data
medicaid_sdud.note: Prescription counts by state, quarter and product, 2022 to Q1 2026. Medicaid only; all indications; rows under 11 prescriptions suppressed. Spending columns not used.

sec_edgar.label: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries — SEC filings
sec_edgar.note: Filing index from the SEC submissions API. Document links follow the standard EDGAR path and were not individually opened.

essts_2022.label: European clinical guidelines for Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders, version 2.0. Part III: pharmacological treatment
essts_2022.note: Aripiprazole preferred among dopamine-blocking agents; tiapride, risperidone, and clonidine/guanfacine (especially with ADHD) can be considered; pimozide, haloperidol, topiramate, cannabis-based agents and botulinum toxin in treatment-resistant cases. Verified from the abstract; full text not read.

aacap_2013.label: Practice parameter for the assessment and treatment of children and adolescents with tic disorders
aacap_2013.publisher: J Am Acad Child Adolesc Psychiatry 2013;52(12):1341-1359 (AACAP)
aacap_2013.note: Recommends comprehensive evaluation including comorbid disorders and a hierarchical approach to multimodal interventions. Agent-level positions not verified against the primary text.
